name: calculate-mcp
description: Deterministic calculation tools for LLMs via MCP.
long_description: A deterministic numerical execution layer for LLMs. Includes expression evaluation, high-precision decimals, unit conversion, statistics, percentages, finance, root solving, matrices, complex numbers, numerical calculus, probability distributions, and date calculations.

tools.name: calculate_expression
tools.description: Evaluate arithmetic and scientific expressions safely.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert common physical and data units.

tools.name: summarize_statistics
tools.description: Compute descriptive statistics for numeric data.

tools.name: calculate_percentage
tools.description: Calculate percentages, changes, increases, and decreases.

tools.name: calculate_finance
tools.description: Compute compound values and loan payments.

tools.name: solve_root
tools.description: Find bracketed numerical roots with bisection.

tools.name: calculate_matrix
tools.description: Perform matrix arithmetic, inversion, determinants, and linear solves.

tools.name: calculate_complex
tools.description: Perform complex-number arithmetic and related operations.

tools.name: calculate_calculus
tools.description: Compute numerical derivatives and definite integrals.

tools.name: calculate_probability
tools.description: Evaluate normal, binomial, and Poisson probabilities.

tools.name: calculate_date
tools.description: Calculate date differences, weekdays, offsets, and business days.
